title: Yummy Vietnamese Beef Pho
description: A bitter, cheese-pull, lazy-sunday Vietnamese dish featuring umeboshi that balances raw-friendly veggies with a quick stir-fry touch.
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a large pot and add beef shank with onion and carrot; simmer for 20 minutes to make broth.
Remove the bones and strain the broth, discarding solids, then return it to the pot.
Stir in fish sauce, sugar, and umeboshi paste until dissolved, then bring to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes.
While broth simmers, rinse rice noodles in cold water, then boil them in separate pot for 3 minutes; drain and set aside.
In a skillet, lightly sear thin sirloin slices on high heat for 1 minute per side, then set aside to finish in the broth.
Place bean sprouts, cucumber ribbons, and a handful of cilantro in a serving bowl.
Pour hot broth over the vegetables and add the seared beef slices, noodles, and a sprinkle of chili flakes.
Top the pho with shredded mozzarella cheese and let it melt slightly from the heat of the broth.
Squeeze lime juice over the bowl and give everything a gentle stir before serving.
